title: When does an agent team beat equal-cost independent work?
objective: Formulate and design a decisive comparison of pair, directed-workflow, and bounded-network collaboration under correlated errors and a fixed whole-system resource budget.
deliverables: An explicit stochastic error model separating common-cause errors, independent errors, and communication-induced dependence
A qualified theorem attempt or counterexample for one topology advantage
A fixed-budget experiment design including a single-worker baseline and independent retries
A scoring rubric for correctness, evidence, uncertainty, time, messages, and resource use
A report identifying assumptions that prevent extrapolation to open-ended discovery
success_criteria: All compared systems receive comparable tools and evidence
The comparison counts orchestration, verification, communication, and repeated work
First-pass independent outputs are isolated before reconciliation
A measured gain would be distinguished from a voting or verbosity artifact
stop_conditions: The assignment or round budget is exhausted
A fair resource match or independent scoring procedure cannot be specified
The model assumes away the error correlation central to the question
The analysis only restates an existing ensemble result without a useful extension
